title: Agent Commerce Order Request
description: A request from a buyer's agent. It is never a completed purchase: the buyer must have approved it, and the seller must accept it. Version 0.1 (draft).

name.description: The agent product making the request.

contact.description: How the seller can reach the buyer (relayed by the server, not published).

buyer_approval.description: Evidence that the human buyer approved this exact request (item, quantity, price and fulfillment) before it was sent.

statement.description: What the buyer was shown and agreed to, in plain words.

max_total.description: The most the buyer agreed to pay, in the listing's currency.
